plain_english: Much-cremation-garland-ghoul-girt, shown sense-field-measuring-midst — Consciousness-Bhairava am I — thus.
In You alone nectar-streak, supreme-power-made, ultimate-knower — hence Lord — You indeed worlds' life — thus shine our in-heart.
sanskrit_cite: tvayy evāmṛtalekhā paraśaktimayī parapramātātaḥ nātha tvam eva jagatām jīvanam iti bhāsi no hṛdaye

plain_english: Yours sound-mass-bodied eightfold-ward just outer-retinue — by supreme-subtle-splits, Bhairava, world-lord-led.
sanskrit_cite: tava śabdarāśivapuṣaḥ pratyaṣṭakam eva bāhyaparivāraḥ parasūkṣmādivibhedād bhairava lokeśvarapramukhāḥ

plain_english: Seals all this by total-own-form-transmission — delights devotee-throng, path-joy, by fullness-showing.
sanskrit_cite: mudrayati nikhilam etan niḥśeṣasvasvarūpasaṃkramaṇāt modayati bhaktavargaṃ gatimudaṃ pūrṇatāprathanāt

plain_english: Looses noose-net, melts distinction — O Lord, Your form seals much-consciousness-wealth — seal hence called.
sanskrit_cite: mocayati pāśajālaṃ drāvayati vibhedam īśa te mūrtiḥ mudrayati vividhasaṃviddraviṇaṃ mudrā tataḥ kathitā

plain_english: Conquers in supreme-principle-ground-excellent — draught-become-this — clearly may it dwell — by true-principle-showing, of heart known-stain.
sanskrit_cite: jayati paratattvabhūmipravare nipāyabhūtaiṣa sphuṭam adhivasatu satattvaprathayā hṛdayasya meyamalam

plain_english: Momently rises consciousness — which indeed there flashes below — world Śiva-Śakti-glory-formed know, Maheśa, rite-standers.
sanskrit_cite: pratikalam udeti saṃvid yā kila tatra sphuraty adho viśvam śivaśaktivibhavarūpaṃ jānanti maheśa yāgasthāḥ

plain_english: Thus You flash always in me — Consciousness-Bhairava, all-beings-self — then rite-to-mantra-end accomplished effortlessly — all.
sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ sphurasi sadā me cidbhairava sarvabhūtātma tad yāgādijapāntaṃ sampannam ayatnataḥ sarvam
